decisions.decision: Merged D040's restatement of Civ. Code 1947.12 into the D024 record (official text, operative 2024-04-01).
1947.12 yields_to LA, SF, Berkeley and Santa Ana rent rules (all cap below 5% + CPI, subd. (d)(3)); not San Diego (no local cap). 1946.2 yields_to the five CA city just cause rules per subd. (i).
1950.5 small-landlord 2-month cap modeled as a variant in key_value/exemptions with exempt_if null: the statute covers every landlord, only the number differs, so no address should lose the rule.

LA just cause: one record citing the JCO (L.A.M.C. 165.00 et seq.) with applies_if null; RSO 151.09 (RSO units) described in coverage and interaction; merged D041, D043 candidates. Dropped the extractor's single-family exemption: D040 says that exemption is from state law, not the JCO.

LA deposit interest (151.06.02) kept as a rule: D041 (supplied) lists deposit interest under the RSO, X020 gives the section; applies_if RSO coverage (co_date <= 1978-10-01) instead of an unavailable leaf.
LA RSO effective_date 2026-02-02 (LAHD) with conflict_flag for the 2026-01-24 landlord-association date; merged D042 rate candidate into it.
LA algorithmic: no_rule (D039 motion only; X018 Aug 2026 survey omits LA). San Diego rent: no_rule (D073 mandated notice points to state 1947.12).
San Diego algorithmic: D076 quoted (citation credit), status in_force and 2025-06-21 from X015; X015 and X018 candidates merged.
San Diego screening filled from new X028 per orchestrator (supplemental, no citation credit).
Santa Ana algorithmic: X018 (2026-04-02, NS-3090) chosen over X008/X009 (no number, no date); dates consistent with final vote 2026-03-03.
Santa Ana rent: year_built (law says 'constructed after February 1, 1995'), with 1995 itself left UNKNOWN.

Tenancy-length conditions (12 months under 1946.2, 6 months under the JCO, 30 days in Santa Ana) kept in coverage text, not applies_if, since tenancy facts are per tenant and would make every address unknown.

Dropped pure 'unavailable' exemption leaves for rare special housing (hotels, dorms, care facilities, deed-restricted affordable housing, shared bath or kitchen with owner) from exempt_if, because one such leaf makes every address unknown; they stay in the exemptions text. Leaves the data can partly decide (units, building age) are kept as conjunctions.

Effective dates of amended statutes: 1946.2 and 1950.6 use the 2026-01-01 amendment date (version now operative); 1950.5 uses 2024-07-01 (cap set by AB 12, per subd. (c)(6) and the brief); 12955 uses 2020-01-01 (SB 329, per audit follow-up).

Audit follow-up: CA screening cited as Cal. Gov. Code § 12955 (SB 329), effective 2020-01-01 per X021 and the brief, confidence 0.6; SB 267 (2024-01-01) kept in requirement and interaction. Replaces the earlier 2024-01-01 choice.

Audit follow-up: AB 325 interaction no longer cites the constitutional default; date rests on T1, X024 and the brief. Dropped the claim that subd. (c) protects local bans: (c) only preserves the Cartwright Act ('antitrust laws' = this part).
Audit follow-up: LA deposit key_value no longer hard-codes the 2025 rate; effective_date stays null because 1990-11-01 is the interest accrual start, not the section's effective date.
conflict_flag used only for the LA RSO date discrepancy; no preemption conflicts in this group (state 16729 does not displace local bans).

Added date_kind to every dated record: 'version' for 1947.12 (2024-04-01 operative SB 567 text), 1946.2 (AB 1529 amendment), 1950.5 (AB 12 cap), 1950.6 (AB 1170 amendment) and LA RSO (2026-02-02 formula), since earlier versions were in force; 'law' for the rest (SB 329 voucher protection, AB 325, LA 45.65, SD 98.0704 added 2023-06-24, SD div. 8, SD div. 11, Santa Ana 2021 ordinances, NS-3090). No dates changed.

SF rent: one record S.F. Admin. Code ch. 37 from D080 (1.6% from 2026-03-01); D083 repeats the rate; co_date <= 1979-06-13 cutoff confirmed by D079 ('Certificate of Occupancy after June 13, 1979' exempt from rent limits).

SF rent exempt_if left null: Costa-Hawkins eligibility and 'some tenancies' regulated by another agency are tenancy-level facts the text does not tie to any building fact; kept in exemptions text so a pre-1979 multifamily building resolves to applies, matching the brief's 20-unit 1962 illustration.
SF just cause: D079 (S.F. Admin. Code § 37.9) is canonical; D082/D083 relocation tables folded into key_value; effective_date null (no date in text).

SF deposits: kept a low-confidence (0.5) record from D083 (Rent Board deposit interest rate 4.2%); the page names no ordinance, so citation is the Rent Board rate, not a code section. Real cite believed to be S.F. Admin. Code ch. 49 but UNVERIFIED in any corpus text: gap-fill needed.

Orchestrator follow-up 2: CA2-04 updated from X031 (S.F. Police Code Sec. 4906): citation 'S.F. Police Code art. 49, § 4906' (X031 prints Sec. 4906 and refers to Secs. 4903 and 4907; 'art. 49' follows from the section numbering, the text does not print the article heading), key_value and requirement from X031, D078 span and source kept for citation credit. effective_date 2026-08-10: the history note shows the current text took effect with Ord. 128-26 (Eff. 8/10/2026) and does not say which amendment set each subsection, so the contract rule 'date the version now operative took effect' gives 2026-08-10; the housing rule itself has been operative since 2014-08-13 (Ord. 17-14), noted in interaction.

SF screening (superseded by follow-up 2 for cite and date): D078 only names the Fair Chance Ordinance and says it covers affordable housing decisions; no code section cited (Police Code art. 49 not in any text), applies_if is an unavailable affordable-housing leaf so lookups are unknown.
SF fees: no_rule based on the brief's illustrative SF lookup (state-only screening fee row); no SF doc mentions a local fee rule.

SF algorithmic: D081 gives the exact effective date 2024-10-14; merged X018 (October 2024, same) into it; D039 (approved July 2024) and D076 (adopted September 2024) give adoption, not effective, dates.

Berkeley rent: merged D006 (5% AGA cap), D008 (2026 AGA 1.0%, no earlier than 2026-01-01, BMC 13.76.110A) and D009 (coverage) into one ch. 13.76 record sourced from D008. Coverage uses year_built < 1980 because both D006 and D009 say 'built before 1980'; partial-coverage cutoff is 'certificate of occupancy after June 1980' (D009) vs 'after 1980' (D006), noted in coverage_conditions. Berkeley rows have no year_built or units, so lookups resolve unknown.

Berkeley just cause: D006 and D009 candidates merged into one ch. 13.76 record (D006 quote, D009 coverage, D004 relocation $19,413 / $6,471 from 2026-01-01); effective_date null because no Measure BB effective date is stated.
Berkeley deposits: deposit interest under the Rent Ordinance (ch. 13.76, D007 and D009) recorded; the deposit cap is state law and belongs to CA1's Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.5 record.

Berkeley fees: ch. 13.78 (D005) recorded as a local rule (disclosure statement and no non-refundable fees for existing tenants); dropped the extractor's conflicts_with CA because the chapter complements the state cap.

Berkeley screening: ch. 13.106 (D003); exempt_if encodes only the building-level owner-occupied 1 to 3 unit exemption; applicant- or tenancy-level exemptions (lifetime sex offenders, roommate additions, owner move-back agreements) stay in text.

Berkeley algorithmic: ch. 13.63 from D001 with effective_date 2026-03-01 per participant guide section 9 (organizer statement of the ordinance text date), conflict_flag true against X018's January 2026; D001 itself carries no date.

Orchestrator follow-up: removed standalone unavailable leaves for rare housing types from Berkeley CA2-06/07/08 predicates (single-family pre-1996 tenancy, rooming house, owner shares kitchen or bath, university housing, nonprofit cooperative, condominium, Section 202/811/HUD-insured subsidy) because the sample is assessor-classified multifamily and they forced unknown everywhere; kept them in exemptions/coverage_conditions text. Kept golden duplex AND units == 2 and owner-occupied ADU AND units <= 2 conjunctions; CA2-06 applies_if is now year_built < 1980 AND units >= 2.

Orchestrator follow-up 3: added date_kind to dated records: version for CA2-01 (SF annual rate year), CA2-03 (SF deposit rate year), CA2-04 (Ord. 128-26 amendment of a 2014 ordinance), CA2-06 (Berkeley 2026 AGA); law for CA2-05 (SF 37.10C first effective 2024-10-14) and CA2-11 (Berkeley ch. 13.63). Caveat on CA2-11: D001 is titled 'AMENDING CHAPTER 13.63', so an earlier ch. 13.63 existed; whether it was in force is not shown in any text, so law is kept per orchestrator instruction.
No yields_to/conflicts_with on SF or Berkeley records: no text says a local rule defers to state law; CA1's state rent and just cause records should yield to these cells.
MA rent: two records, c.40P s.4 (in_force) and IP 25-21 (failed, organizer T5 MA-RENT-P1); IP 25-21 sourced from X023 because no supplied D doc covers it.
MA fees: two instruments, c.186 s.15B(1)(b) upfront-charge limit and c.112 s.87DDD1/2 broker fee, both named as fee examples in the brief; s.15B also carries the deposit record.
c.186 s.15B effective_date 2025-08-01 = date of the operative clause (1)(b) text (2025 c.9 ss.54-55) shown in D052; the one-month cap predates it.
H.3744 (D011) not recorded as a rule (organizers do not name it); used as evidence in the Boston rent and just-cause no_rule notes.

Boston screening: two instruments, DND Fair Chance policy (D010, applies_if unavailable: DND-funded/inclusionary only) and Fair Housing Regulations rental-assistance protection (D012, weak cite, conf 0.45).
Algorithmic: S.2983 (D046; D047 duplicate history) and H.5222 (D045) pending, effective_date null (T4). Cambridge policy order (X026) is not an instrument: no_rule.
Boston and Cambridge deposits/fees/algorithmic no_rule are inferred from state statutes covering the field and silence of all city sources, not from an explicit city statement.

Orchestrator policy: removed the lone 'unavailable' vacation-rental (100 days or less) exempt_if from MA-03 and MA-04 so s.15B resolves to applies (wording kept in exemptions); remaining unavailable leaves are MA-09 applies_if (DND/inclusionary coverage condition, kept) and MA-11 exempt_if (owner-occupied conjoined with units == 2, kept).
Audit follow-up: added MA screening record 803 CMR 5.00 (MA-12) from supplemental X029 (D056 link-only), effective 2021-06-11; MA screening now has c.151B s.4 and 803 CMR 5.00.

Audit follow-up: Boston and Cambridge just cause changed from no_rule to notice-of-rights records, HSNA § 10-11.7 (MA-13, D013, eff. 2020-11-06 per D014, conf 0.6) and Cambridge ch. 8.71 (MA-14, D031, date null, conf 0.5); rare-facility exemptions kept only in text. MA state just cause stays no_rule; H.3744 still not a record.
Audit follow-up: citations aligned to organizer wording, MA-02 'Mass. Initiative Petition 25-21 (IP 25-21)', MA-05 'M.G.L. c.112 § 87DDD½'.

date_kind added: version for c.186 s.15B deposit and upfront charges (2025 amendment) and 803 CMR 5.00 (2021 amendment); law for c.112 s.87DDD1/2 fee-payment rule (new 2025-08-01), Boston HSNA (2020-11-06) and Boston DND Fair Chance policy (2017-02, no earlier version in the source).

Audit fix: Hoboken ch. 155 effective_date 2019-01-16 to 2023-02-01: ecode tags precede their section (X002 '[Added 9-3-1986]' sits over sec. 155-6.1; TOC X001 names 155-5 'Expiration or termination of lease', matching the cap text), so the cap's tag is B-532 of 2-1-2023 and B-104 belongs to the tax surcharge.
Audit fix: NJ-01 citation to the brief's form N.J.S.A. 2A:18-61.1; quoted_span now a single raw line of D067.
Audit fix: key_values trimmed to headline: NJ-02 '1.5 months' rent' (organizer sample record), NJ-03 '$50 cap, CPI-adjusted yearly'; details stay in requirement.
Audit fix: NJ-05 citation N.J.S.A. 10:5-12 (D067 prints 10:5-12(g) to -(h)).

Audit fix: NJ-08 now sourced from the official Ord. 25-057 text (X030) instead of X018; effective_date stays 2025-06 (X030 gives only adoption 2025-05-21 and approval 2025-05-22); X030 extractor's note naming the FAIR Act P.L.2025, c.405 not copied (it is P.L.2026, c.43).

NJ just cause: D067 quoted (citation metric), X011 statute supports exemptions; hotel/motel and trust-unit exceptions kept in text only (outside ordinary residential rentals), so apartment buildings resolve instead of all-unknown.

NJ deposits: merged D067, X012 (46:8-21.2) and X013 (46:8-26 coverage section of the same act) into one record cited N.J.S.A. 46:8-21.2; effective_date null because '2003' and '1979' are amendment years, not effective dates of the operative text.
NJ fees: real-estate-licensee carve-out left out of exempt_if (it exempts the agent, not the building); 1-2 family dwelling exemption encoded as units <= 2.

NJ screening: two instruments kept separate: Fair Chance in Housing Act (P.L.2021, c.110, D065) and LAD source of income (N.J.S.A. 10:5-12(g), D068 quote, D067 cite); merged D067 and D068 LAD candidates into one record.
FAIR Act: conflict_flag false per orchestrator (rule-level flag would flag Newark too); preemption expressed only via conflicts_with on NJ-06, NJ-08, NJ-10, with the section 6.b quote in interaction.
Dropped X006 conflicts_with NJ screening: neither the Newark ordinance nor P.L.2021, c.110 contains a preemption clause, and X006's reference to a 'FAIR Act' screening law was wrong.

Jersey City rent control: applies_if units >= 5 (D036 '1-4 Unit Properties are exempt'), so missing units gives unknown; Hoboken exempt_if stays unknown for all addresses because coverage section 155-2 was not captured.
Newark rent control: replaced static co_date 1996-10-01 leaf with rolling building_age_years < 30 plus certification; public housing, hotel, commercial and program exemptions kept in text only.
Hoboken ban dated 2025-07-09 (adoption, X003) rather than '2025-07', which the engine would read as July 1, before adoption.
Hoboken ch. 158 art. I (Ord. B-750, disclosure of whether a rent algorithm was used for increases over 10%) not recorded: a disclosure duty, not a limit or ban; the brief names only art. II.

date_kind added: law for NJ-03, NJ-04, NJ-06, NJ-08, NJ-10, NJ-12; version for NJ-09 (B-532 amendment of the 1984 ch. 155) and NJ-11 (6PSF-I amendment of the 2017 ordinance). NJ-12 marked law per orchestrator, though X006 shows a predecessor Ord. 6 PSF-F (2012), repealed in full in 2015, whose housing content is not in the corpus.
